changes.summary: Gemini native Chat Completions tools and grounding/URL metadata survive JSON and streaming requests without bypassing stream-event hooks.
Provider-executed tools bypass response caches; unsupported cross-protocol translation is rejected rather than silently dropping tools.
Native upgrade and recovery acceptance includes the published v2.11.7, v2.12.0 and v2.12.1 baselines.
Native lifecycle fixtures disable background release discovery before first boot, preserving strict configuration-drift rejection and customer defaults.
Opaque Gemini function-call thought signatures survive Chat Completions JSON, SSE and next-turn history, with parallel index/ID correlation and late-signature draining.
Native upgrade, Fleet and recovery acceptance includes the published v2.12.3 baseline so existing installations can upgrade to this release.
Google/OpenRouter tool-signature compatibility for Chat Completions JSON, SSE and next-turn history, with real pi 0.73.1/1.3.0 client tests and v2.12.4 upgrade acceptance.
Model-aware Gemini thinking_level/thinking_budget compatibility for proxy and official upstream request formats.

Additive pricing-engine-019 index lets the 30-second pricing recovery sweep find attempts by reservation instead of scanning the attempt history on the event loop; installations with the pricing schema apply it with pricing-migrate. Native upgrade acceptance includes the published v2.12.6 baseline.

Pricing audit-marker checks and dashboard log-summary snapshot reads use primary-key lookups instead of scanning the workspace history on the event loop; no schema change or migration. Native upgrade acceptance includes the published v2.12.7 baseline.
